source_text: Responsa ad Abram et Abraham differunt. Ante nomen mutatum: exi de terra tua — nondum circumcisio. Post exitum: Abraham, testamentum et circumcisio. Nomen carnale testamentum Dei prius ferre non poterat.
pass_a_gloss: Answers toward Abram and Abraham differ. Before name changed: go-out from land your — not-yet circumcision. After going-out: Abraham, covenant and circumcision. Name fleshly covenant of-God earlier to-bear not was-able.
pass_b_english: Oracles to Abram and to Abraham differ. Before the name-change: [[Go out from your land >> Bible:Genesis 12:1]] — not yet circumcision. After he went out: Abraham, the covenant and circumcision. The fleshly name could not yet bear God’s covenant.
